notes: Daily Quests, Skills, Milestones, Titles & Trails, Atlas of the Realm and Realm News write their saved data less often (Daily Quests no longer on every counted block), and Skills no longer forgets blocks placed just before the Realm closes.
Champions and the Bounty Board cost the server less: mob farms and dropped items no longer wake Champions up, and a Stormcaller strike or a new bounty target no longer makes one long tick.
Quick Stack & Sort costs the server much less while you mine on a nearly full inventory page: auto-store moves pickups at most once a second, all together.
Fishing costs the server much less: one pack follows each bobber and shares every catch with Skills, the Journal, Daily Quests and Story Questlines.
Side HUD: the right-side boxes now show on short phone screens when the Minimap radar is hidden.
Rain Charm and Tide Boots now work on beaches and on sandstone paths in the rain.
Story Blood Moons and Harvest Moons never come two nights in a row, and never replace a moon an operator chose.
Mining the same stone spot again within 5 minutes gives no Mining XP, so cobblestone and basalt generators do not farm it.
The sky-wonder bonus in Frogs in Three Voices also works with Rainbows, Tornadoes or Storm Cells.
Town Projects residents can no longer breed.

Townsfolk cost the server much less, most of all with many players online away from town; a townsfolk standing next to an armor stand, painting or pet no longer has its name label flicker every 10 seconds.

Easy Building: a resting preview no longer flips between the box and the shape, big previews no longer stall the server, and survival blocks that could not reach an unloaded chunk are handed back instead of lost.

Minimap radar: a full terrain cache no longer leaves radars blank for minutes after a big scan, and costs the server less while players travel; players can scan up to 128 blocks with /realm:minimap scan (operators 384).
Easy Building: big builds, digs, copies, cuts and pastes no longer freeze the server: the blocks are read and written a few at a time, and an undo while a build is still going stops it.

Weather and sky effects cost phones and the server much less: the little rainbow over a pot of gold, the tornado funnel, a NOS boost and claim and zone outlines send far fewer particles, and players can lower a tornado's funnel density for their own screen in /realm:prefs.
Minimap radar: with players moving it costs the server about a third of what it did (about 4 ms a tick instead of 11 to 14), and with 10 players the land under the radar fills in far faster.

Opening /realm:prefs or /realm:config no longer stalls the server for a moment (each pack builds its part of the menu without repeated work), /realm:help opens at once, and the packs stop asking each other which packs are installed every few minutes.
resourceNotes: Side HUD: the right-side boxes start right under the compass when the Minimap radar is hidden, so they show on short phone screens.
Realistic Rain: the long thunderstorm, wind and muffled-rain clips are streamed as they play instead of loaded whole into memory, which should leave phones more memory during storms.
Realm Skies: new particles for the little rainbow over a pot of gold and a NOS boost's plume, and a tornado funnel of fewer, slightly bigger clouds that looks the same at about half the particles.
